# ARA Rental

> > News and resources for the equipment and event rental industry from the American Rental Association

ARA Rental provides industry news, safety resources, market analysis, and operational best practices for rental businesses through Rental Management Media Group. Coverage includes equipment rental, event rental, specialty rentals, and emerging trends affecting the rental industry.

## Key Topics

- American Rental Association (ARA)
- Rental Management Media Group
- Equipment rental industry
- Event rental operations
- Specialty rentals
- ARA Insurance and risk management
- Workplace safety in rental operations
- ARA Foundation
- Young Professionals Network (YPN)
- Market trends and consumer needs
- AI and sustainability in rentals
- Festival and event markets
- Storage and operational best practices
- Corporate announcements and leadership
- Insurance claims analysis

## Industry News & Market Trends

- [Specialty rentals on the rise: Catering to unique consumer needs](https://news.ararental.org/specialty-rentals-on-the-rise-catering-to-unique-consumer-needs): Market trends analysis on specialty rentals growth and consumer needs
- [Can AI enhance sustainability efforts?](https://news.ararental.org/can-ai-enhance-sustainability-efforts): AI applications for sustainability in the rental industry
- [Caterpillar announces C-level changes](https://news.ararental.org/caterpillar-announces-c-level-changes): Caterpillar executive leadership changes announcement

## Safety & Risk Management

- [Safety poster: The most frequent and severe insurance claims](https://news.ararental.org/safety-poster-the-most-frequent-and-severe-insurance-claims): ARA Insurance 2022 claims data safety poster for rental operations

## Event Rental Operations

- [Serving the festival market in the event rental industry](https://news.ararental.org/serving-the-festival-market-in-the-event-rental-industry): Festival market strategies and operations for event rental businesses
- [Storage best practices: Ideas for pipe, drape and crowd control items](https://news.ararental.org/storage-best-practices-ideas-for-pipe-drape-and-crowd-control-items): Best practices guide for storing pipe, drape, and crowd control equipment
